title: Share of US rural hospitals considered vulnerable to closure

source.name: Rural Health Safety Net report, 2025 edition

notes: Chartis's 2025 rural health report counted 432 rural hospitals -- roughly 1 in 5 of the nation's rural hospitals -- as vulnerable to closure, up from 418 the year before, with 46% of all rural hospitals operating at a financial loss. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
